sources.source_name: NWS modern alerts API and CAP products
sources.access_method: HTTPS GET with User-Agent; GeoJSON, Atom, and per-alert CAP XML
sources.machine_readable_availability: Verified live GeoJSON, Atom XML, and CAP XML on 2026-07-29.
sources.authentication_requirements: No credential; descriptive User-Agent required by published guidance.
sources.terms_usage_constraints: Public federal alert data; follow NWS API etiquette and identification guidance.
sources.geographic_coverage: United States; route tested by point query, King County zone query, and Washington statewide query.
sources.route_points_sections_covered: WP1-WP8 and all route sections via direct point sampling plus county/state backstop queries.
sources.available_fields: Alert id, CAP identifier, event, headline, description, instruction, response, severity, certainty, urgency, sent, effective, onset, expires, ends, SAME and UGC geocodes, affectedZones, references, senderName.
sources.geometry_availability: GeoJSON geometry may be null; CAP geocodes, affected zones, and area descriptions remain available when null.
sources.historical_availability: Current active indexes verified; historical endpoint family documented but not deeply profiled this cycle.
sources.pagination_behavior: GeoJSON can paginate; small tested result sets did not paginate. Atom is a filtered feed snapshot.
sources.documented_rate_limits: NWS documents a generous but undisclosed limit.
sources.failure_detection_method: HTTP non-200, invalid JSON/XML, stale updated timestamp, or inconsistent point versus zone behavior.
sources.fallback_method: AlertSeattle, UW Alert, and local municipal feeds for local confirmation.
sources.manual_review_requirement: Medium only for final rider-facing interpretation when CAP geometry is null or when a civil alert overlaps weather or flood ownership.
sources.research_notes: Strongest structured route-wide source. On Wednesday, July 29, 2026, the route point and King County zone queries returned valid zero-alert states while the statewide query returned four off-route Air Quality Alerts, proving both live data and overlap risk.
